tagline: Africa's quiet success story — a calm diamond-funded capital that serves as the gateway to the Okavango Delta.
overview: Gaborone — 'Gabs' to locals — is the capital of Africa's quiet success story: Botswana's diamond-funded stability built an orderly, safe city that functions as the staging post for the world's most exclusive safaris.

The city is modest by design: the Three Dikgosi monument to the founding chiefs, the Main Mall's markets, and the mokolodi game reserve on the edge. The real draw is what lies beyond — the Okavango Delta's flooded wilderness, Chobe's elephant herds and the Makgadikgadi's zebra migration.
Speed's 2025 Africa tour streamed from Gaborone. Botswana keeps tourism deliberately low-volume and high-value — the delta camps are among the world's most sought-after safaris.
